name: jest-to-vitest-migration
description: Migrates a Jest test suite to Vitest, translating config and mocks. Use when a session's task involves converting jest.config or jest imports to vitest equivalents.

trigger.description: User asks to migrate a package's test suite from Jest to Vitest, or session touches jest.config.* and vitest is present in package.json.
signals: jest.config.js present alongside a vitest dependency

prerequisites: Node project with an existing Jest test suite

steps.action: Run the existing jest suite to capture a baseline of passing tests
steps.why: Establishes a pass/fail baseline before touching any config.

steps.action: Create a vitest.config.ts file that mirrors the jest.config.js settings
steps.why: Vitest reads its own config file rather than jest.config.js.

steps.action: Replace jest globals with vitest imports across each test file
steps.why: Vitest does not inject globals by default.

steps.action: Be thorough and use best judgment
steps.why: Vague catch-all step, deliberately not concrete.

decision_points.condition: Did the baseline jest run reveal any already-failing tests?
decision_points.if_true: Record the pre-existing failures separately so the migration diff is not blamed for them
decision_points.if_false: Proceed directly to creating the vitest config

edge_cases: Suite has snapshot tests that need jest.mock translated to vi.mock
Suite relies on a jsdom environment configured only in jest.config.js

sessions.excerpt: migrated jest suite to vitest, all tests passing
replaced jest globals with vitest equivalents
